verified_source_anchors.description: Adaptive question ranking action model with deterministic fallback order.
Contextual burden, cooldown, emergency, and consent state governing question presentation.
Verified ranking protocol allowing learned scorers to order already-eligible questions without altering the eligible action set.
Shadow comparison protocol auditing agreement and top-1 changes between champion deterministic baseline and learned scorers.
Time-series observation unit with strict person, site, revision, and unit consistency.
Sufficiency policy enforcing minimum sample counts and coverage bounds before releasing predictions.
Feature flag gating LifeMap longitudinal trajectory baseline recommendation engine (default: False).

tests_run.description: AST bytecode compilation across modified and created Python sources.

30 focused test cases verifying trajectory metrics, Theil-Sen slope, MAD/IQR dispersion, step-shift detection, baseline recommendations, emergency fast-path, consent gates, cooldown/burden filters, shadow ranking, and concurrency determinism.
Path lane conformance verified across services/ml/src/clara_ml/, evaluation/, and artifacts/PH12/A04/.

longitudinal_trajectory_engine.finding: Implemented LongitudinalTrajectoryEngine in services/ml/src/clara_ml/lifemap/longitudinal_trajectory.py computing non-parametric robust statistics (Theil-Sen slope, MAD, IQR) and step-shift changepoint detection without any mock data.

personal_baseline_recommendation.finding: Implemented deterministic baseline action evaluator returning establish, maintain, recalibrate, refresh_stale, or increase_monitoring actions with explicit confidence scores, decision rule IDs, and bilingual (Vietnamese/English) clinical assistant rationales.

longitudinal_next_best_question.finding: Implemented question recommendation engine selecting at most one primary question from an approved clinical catalogue, guarded by emergency fast-path short-circuit, Decree 13/Circular 46 purpose consent, daily burden budgets, and dismissal cooldowns.

shadow_ranking_governance.finding: Integrated QuestionScorer protocol and compare_shadow_rankings ensuring candidate learned models cannot invent questions or modify eligible action sets.
